risks.risk: The internal diodes may be burnt or fail.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the diode resistance (around 100 ohms).

risks.risk: The alternator may be a generic or counterfeit part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the 4-digit part number stamped on the housing.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the 4-digit part number stamped on the housing.

Video of a multimeter test showing diode resistance.
response.reason: The item is a Valeo alternator for an M278 Mercedes-Benz, which can be priced at its worst case (non-functional) until proof of output is provided.
